note: Grammar lessons of every level, grouped by what they help you say. Categories are shown in this order; inside a category the lessons run HSK 1 first, then HSK 2 (the order of the lesson files).

categories.name: Building a sentence
categories.blurb: The skeleton of a sentence: who does what, 是, 有, 的 and pronouns.

categories.name: Describing and comparing
categories.blurb: Say what something is like, compare things, and say how well or how completely something is done.

categories.name: Questions
categories.blurb: Yes/no questions, question words, either-or questions, and softening with 吧 and 呢.

categories.name: Saying no, asking and telling
categories.blurb: Say no, make polite requests, and tell someone not to do something.

categories.name: Wanting and being able
categories.blurb: Want, can, may, hope and get ready.

categories.name: Numbers and counting
categories.blurb: Measure words, numbers, money, age, and how much or how many.

categories.name: Time and how often
categories.blurb: Dates and clock time, how often something happens, and when.

categories.name: Where and direction
categories.blurb: Where something is or happens, distance, and which way things move.

categories.name: Happening now and soon
categories.blurb: Actions in progress, states that continue, and things about to happen.

categories.name: Finished and past
categories.blurb: Done, changed, already, experienced, and describing how a past event happened.

categories.name: Joining people and ideas
categories.blurb: With, together, also, then, because and although: link people, actions and sentences.
